Schuss Mountain

January 3, 2025


It’s Fri-yay! Schuss Mountain will be open 9a-9p today.

The magic carpet, purple, pink yellow and blue chairlifts all spinning (blue chairlift will close at 6p) today. Conditions on the hill are a beautiful packed powder, with 28-36” of base in most areas.

The lake effect snow machine is cranking out the snow, both literally and figuratively, with almost 10” of freshies falling since New Year’s Day, as well as giving us the ability to turn on our snow guns again! Our snowmakers will be focusing most of their efforts on the red pod to get it open as soon as possible, but will also be filling in thin spots as needed in various locations around the mountain.

Our Alpine Tubing Park located in Summit Village has four lanes available today from 10a-10p.
